verdict.rationale: Non-documentary database verification is a fair question for an identity-verification product like Sumsub, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents checks against SSN, national registries, or credit-header data. AML screening against sanctions/PEP lists and Reusable KYC data sharing are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify identity against authoritative databases without documents — SSN, national registries, or credit-header data — for lower-friction flows where a doc scan is overkill
